title: Triggers
description: Trigger descriptors, stdio frames, CloudEvents envelope, signed desired state, Trigger Sync and checkpoint transfer (ADR 058). Every string declares maxLength and every array maxItems; opaque values declare x-toolgate-max-bytes.

TriggerId.description: <packageId>/<trigger name>; trigger names share the package export namespace with tools.

TriggerExecutorId.description: Enrolled device or Tool Host identity.

TriggerEventType.description: Reverse-DNS event type ending with a major version.

TriggerEventId.description: Stable source-level event identity, unique per source.

TriggerMessage.description: Bounded human-readable detail; never contains secrets.

TriggerLeaseToken.description: 256-bit random bearer secret, base64url without padding.

TriggerSequence.description: A positive sequence number in one named namespace (plan section 6.2.1).

TriggerCheckpointBody.description: Base64 checkpoint body; inline only up to 4 KiB decoded.

TriggerMode.description: How the SDK drives the trigger.

TriggerExecutor.description: Executor class: Tool Host or endpoint device.

TriggerSourceReplay.description: What the source can replay after downtime (plan 6.5).

TriggerOverflow.description: Outbox overflow policy; DROP_* only for loss-tolerant event types.

TriggerTerminalRejectionPolicy.description: Reviewed reaction to a terminal emit rejection (plan 6.6).

TriggerDesiredState.description: Resolved desired state of one instance.

TriggerEventKind.description: CloudEvent tgkind: a fired event, a state change, or a loss record.

TriggerRejectionReason.description: Why Control tells the executor to drop records and resync.

TriggerFrameKind.description: Trigger-mode frame kinds of tool protocol v2. LOG and BROKER_* frames are unchanged.

TriggerSchedule.description: POLL interval or PUSH resync interval.

TriggerDescriptor.description: Signed semantic descriptor of one trigger export (plan 5.9).

configSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for the assignment config.

eventSchema.description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for event data; fields may carry x-toolgate-classification.

TriggerCloudEvent.description: CloudEvents 1.0 JSON envelope written by the supervisor; authors never set source, type, dataschema or tg* attributes (plan 6.4).

data.description: Event data validated against the signed eventSchema.

TriggerProducer.description: Producer identity Control attaches from the mTLS certificate, lease and signed package; never from the payload.

TriggerDesiredInstance.description: One resolved instance in the desired document (plan 8.1).

config.description: Assignment config, validated against configSchema; at most 8 KiB.

TriggerDesiredDocument.description: Signed desired trigger state for one executor; the payload of a compact JWS by the organization deployment key.

TriggerDesiredJws.description: Compact JWS over TriggerDesiredDocument; at most 4 MiB.

TriggerCounters.description: Monotonic counters for the current process lifetime of one instance.

TriggerInstanceReport.description: Executor snapshot entry for one held instance (plan 8.2).

TriggerSnapshotPage.description: One page of a frozen executor snapshot (plan 8.5). Pages from different generations are never combined.

TriggerCheckpointReport.description: Checkpoint metadata changed since the last ack; the body is inline only up to 4 KiB (plan 8.6).

TriggerOutboxRecord.description: One outbox record sent to Control, oldest unacknowledged first.

TriggerSync.description: Trigger block of every executor check-in (plan 8.2, 8.5).

TriggerOutboxAck.description: Highest contiguous resolved outboxSeq for one (instance, epoch).

TriggerDisposition.description: Control-side terminal rejection of one record.

TriggerRetryLater.description: Retryable rejection; records from fromOutboxSeq are kept and re-sent.

TriggerLease.description: Run lease for one instance (plan 7). It authorizes running and reporting only.

TriggerRejection.description: Drop the outbox entries of this lease epoch, stop the instance and resync. Records of other epochs are unaffected.

TriggerSyncAck.description: Trigger block of the check-in ack (plan 8.3, 8.5).

TriggerCheckpointUploadRequest.description: Start a checkpoint upload; idempotent on (instanceId, version).

TriggerEmitAckFrame.description: Completes or fails one emit() future.

TriggerAcceptedUpToFrame.description: Every emit of this process up to emitSeq is resolved at Control.

TriggerCheckpointAckFrame.description: Barrier advanced to that checkpoint at that level.

TriggerEmitFrame.description: One event; the supervisor wraps it in the CloudEvents envelope.

TriggerCheckpointFrame.description: Explicit checkpoint; subject to the same barrier as position.

TriggerHeartbeatFrame.description: Sent every 10 s by the SDK runtime.

TriggerExitFrame.description: Last frame on a clean stop.

TriggerAssignmentName.description: Assignment name, unique per tenant (a DNS label).

TriggerTarget.description: Where an assignment runs (plan 9.1). CLIENT: devices and Device Groups, minus excluded devices. Entries are unique; Control refuses repeats.

TriggerAssignmentSpec.description: Desired assignment of one trigger definition (plan 9.1).

config.description: Validated against the definition configSchema; at most 8 KiB.

globals.description: Package globals for the instances; at most 8 KiB.

TriggerInstanceCounts.description: Instances of an assignment by phase.

TriggerInstanceChangeKind.description: How a mutation changes one instance.

TriggerInstanceChange.description: One instance a mutation adds, changes or removes.

TriggerAssignmentResult.description: Result of an assignment mutation, or of its dry run.

TriggerDesiredStateSource.description: Where the resolved desired state comes from (plan 9.2).

TriggerDefinitionRecord.description: A trigger export of an uploaded package version (plan 10.2).

securityDelta.description: Against the same trigger in the package version uploaded before this one; all widening for a first version.
